# Governing

> Governing is the leading source for state and local government news, policy analysis, and management best practices for public sector leaders.

Governing covers critical issues facing cities, counties and states including policy, finance, infrastructure, workforce management, and emerging challenges like AI regulation and climate resilience. The publication serves as an essential resource for government officials, administrators and civic leaders navigating complex governance challenges.

## Key Topics

- State Policy
- Public Finance
- AI Regulation
- Infrastructure
- Education Policy
- Criminal Justice
- Public Health
- Climate Resilience
- Public Transit
- Workforce Development
- Property Tax
- Prison Reform
- Renewable Energy
- Rural Development
- Government Administration

## Core Policy Areas

- [Policy](https://www.governing.com/policy): State and local government policymaking in health, education, safety, and emerging areas like AI regulation.
- [Finance](https://www.governing.com/finance): State and local public finance management including taxes, budgets, pensions and bonds.
- [Infrastructure](https://www.governing.com/infrastructure): Funding, building and maintaining roads, rail, broadband, water utilities and related infrastructure.
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.governing.com/artificial-intelligence): AI policy development and guardrails for state and local government applications.
- [Resilience](https://www.governing.com/resilience): Climate policy, emergency response and infrastructure resilience for changing environmental conditions.

## Government Operations & Workforce

- [Management and Administration](https://www.governing.com/management-and-administration): Government administration covering IT governance, procurement, workforce development and management best practices.
- [Workforce](https://www.governing.com/workforce): Public sector labor market, salary, training, retention and union activity in state and local government.

## Urban & Community Development

- [Housing and Urban Issues](https://www.governing.com/urban): Urban solutions for housing affordability, homelessness, zoning and community development.
- [Transportation](https://www.governing.com/transportation): Transit planning, funding and policy for rail, electric vehicles and mass transit systems.

## News & Politics

- [Politics](https://www.governing.com/politics): Political news covering elections, voting rights and legislative dynamics in states and cities.
- [News in Numbers](https://www.governing.com/number): Weekly digest of government statistics and data on policy, finance and elections.

## Multimedia & Resources

- [Magazine](https://www.governing.com/magazine): Governing magazine for public sector leaders on management and policy issues.
- [Governing Podcasts](https://www.governing.com/podcasts): Podcast series covering government policy, cybersecurity, transit and community engagement.

## Optional

- [Who Said That](https://www.governing.com/quote): Database of quotes from government officials on policy and legislative issues.
- [How to Move Away From Inhumane Prisons](https://www.governing.com/management-and-administration/how-to-move-away-from-inhumane-prisons): Analysis of innovative prison reform programs improving safety and post-release success rates.
- [Map: States Where Electricity Costs Went Up the Most in 2025](https://www.governing.com/map-of-the-day/map-states-where-electricity-costs-went-up-the-most-in-2025): Data visualization comparing state electricity cost increases and utility bill trends in 2025.
